rule.description: Recurring multi-parameter groups that thread the same conceptual data through two or more function or method signatures in one package, instead of carrying that data in a single abstraction. The detector compares signatures by parameter-type multiset intersection; parameter names are ignored so the rule is rename-proof. A match requires at least 3 shared parameters spanning at least 2 distinct types, and each participating signature is reported once.
rule.matching: pairwise parameter-type multiset intersection within each package pass; one diagnostic per signature that has at least one qualifying partner

checks.name: assemble-core-request clump
checks.description: The request-assembly step for each event flavor accepts (method, requestURL, body []byte, rawMethod, rawPath) as five separate parameters. All three accessors repeat the identical parameter group; the clump is detected by the shared signature (*http.Request, []byte, string, string, string).

checks.name: append-query-string clump
checks.description: The query-string assembly step for the REST API and ALB flavors accepts (requestURL string, multiValueQueryParameters map[string][]string, queryStringParameters map[string]string) as three separate parameters. Both accessors repeat the identical group.

checks.name: copy-request-headers clump
checks.description: The header-propagation step for the REST API and ALB flavors accepts (httpRequest *http.Request, headers map[string]string, multiValueHeaders map[string][]string) as three separate parameters. Both accessors repeat the identical group.

checks.name: gateway-response clump
checks.description: The terminal response-assembly step for each event flavor accepts (status int, headers http.Header, body string, isBase64Encoded bool) as four separate parameters. All three response writers repeat the identical group; the clump is detected by the shared signature (bool, int, net/http.Header, string).

excluded_candidates.reason: Each adapter package wraps proxyInternal(req *http.Request, err error). The shared *http.Request and error pair spans two distinct types but only two parameters, below the min_shared_params threshold of three. These pairs occur across roughly twenty adapter functions and are deliberately left as the natural pre-existing shape of the codebase.

The addToContext family threads (ctx context.Context, req *http.Request, apiGwRequest <event>) in each flavor. Although three parameters appear, the repeating parameters collapse to at most one distinct type per comparison, below the min_distinct_types threshold of two.

The body-decoding helper is duplicated per accessor in the injected state as (string, bool), sharing two parameters of two distinct types. Two shared parameters is below the min_shared_params threshold of three, so these helpers do not trigger.
Host resolution accepts two string parameters. Two shared parameters of one distinct type is below both thresholds, so these helpers do not trigger.
